content:
Premium customers are being charged full price. Our pricing policy is that an
order placed by a premium user (isPremiumUser: true) gets a 10% discount on its
totalPrice, rounded up to the nearest whole number. Orders from non-premium
users are charged their totalPrice unchanged. The price stored for the order,
and returned when the order is fetched with GET /order/:id, must be the final
price. Please fix this.

Work within this local repository and the context you have been given. Do not

Premium orders now get the 10% discount, rounded up, before the order is saved, so the stored price and what `GET /order/:id` returns are the final price.

The change is in `example-application/business-logic/order-service.js`. When `isPremiumUser` is `true`, `totalPrice` becomes `Math.ceil(totalPrice * 0.9)`; non-premium orders are saved unchanged. For example, a premium order of 59 is stored as 54.

All Jest suites pass (37 passed, 2 skipped, 10 todo). I did not add a test for the discount itself. ESLint couldn't run: it errors with no `eslint.config.js` found (ESLint 9), which is not caused by this change.

The order event published to the `order.events` queue now carries the discounted price too, since it uses the same updated order object.
